description: This Java class `CatalogQueryService` provides read-only catalog query operations such as fetching products and categories by various identifiers. It acts as an entry point for catalog data retrieval, typically called by REST controllers, and interacts with repository interfaces for data access.

classes.name: CatalogQueryService
classes.description: A service class providing read-only catalog query operations such as retrieving products and categories for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getProductByStoreAndSku
methods.description: Retrieves a product by store ID and SKU, throws NoSuchElementException if not found.

methods.name: listProducts
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of products for a merchant store.

methods.name: listCategories
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of categories for a merchant store.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its UUID, throws NoSuchElementException if not found.
